title: DICOM Anonymization & HIPAA De-identification
text: dicomtk implements HIPAA Safe Harbor DICOM PS3.15 Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile via dicom_anonymize(). Unlike legacy wrappers invoke external dcmodify subprocesses, dicomtk performs de-identification natively C++17 memory.
code: library(dicomtk) library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union  # Create a synthetic DICOM file containing PHI tags mat <- matrix(seq(0, 255), nrow = 16, ncol = 16) raw_dcm <- tempfile(fileext = ".dcm") write_dicom(   mat,   raw_dcm,   metadata = list(     PatientName = "DOE^JOHN",     PatientID = "MRN-987654",     PatientBirthDate = "19800415",     StudyDate = "20251016",     InstitutionName = "GENERAL HOSPITAL",     Modality = "CT"   ) )  # Inspect original PHI tags dicom_tag_value(   raw_dcm,   c("PatientName", "PatientID", "PatientBirthDate", "StudyDate", "InstitutionName") ) #>        PatientName          PatientID   PatientBirthDate          StudyDate  #>         "DOE^JOHN"       "MRN-987654"         "19800415"         "20251016"  #>    InstitutionName  #> "GENERAL HOSPITAL"  # Anonymize with longitudinal date shifting (-100 days), UID regeneration, and private tag removal anon_dcm <- dicom_anonymize(   raw_dcm,   patient_name = "TRIAL^SUBJECT_001",   patient_id = "SUBJ_001",   shift_days = -100L,   erase_private = TRUE,   regenerate_uids = TRUE )  # Verify de-identification dicom_tag_value(   anon_dcm,   c("PatientName", "PatientID", "StudyDate", "InstitutionName", "PatientIdentityRemoved") ) #>            PatientName              PatientID              StudyDate  #>    "TRIAL^SUBJECT_001"             "SUBJ_001"             "20250708"  #>        InstitutionName PatientIdentityRemoved  #>                     NA                  "YES"

title: PACS Networking & DICOM Query/Retrieve
text: dicomtk provides tidyverse-friendly interface DICOM networking (dcmnet, dcmqrdb, dcmwlm, dcmtls): - dicom_connect(): Configure remote DIMSE PACS peer, DICOMweb REST endpoint, local PACS storage directory. - dicom_tls_config(): Configure BCP 195 TLS transport security (dcmtls). - dicom_echo(): Verify connectivity via DICOM Upper Layer -ASSOCIATE-RQ + C-ECHO-RQ. - dicom_find(): Query studies, series, instances tidy tibble. - dicom_get(): Retrieve matched DICOM files local directory. - dicom_send() / dicom_receive(): Store receive DICOM objects (C-STORE). - dicom_qrdb_index() & dicom_worklist(): Local index database (dcmqrdb) Modality Worklist (dcmwlm).
code: library(dicomtk) library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union  dcm_file <- system.file("extdata", "example.dcm", package = "dicomtk")  # 1. Start a local PACS storage receiver (SCP directory) pacs_dir <- tempfile("local_pacs_") conn <- dicom_receive(pacs_dir, port = 11112, aetitle = "DICOMTK-SCP") conn #> ℹ DICOM Connection: DICOMTK-SCP -> DICOMTK-SCP@127.0.0.1:11112 #> ℹ Local PACS directory: C:\Users\lauye\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpOw6Eyu\local_pacs_56b44b6c70b  # 2. title: CLAUDE.md — dicomtk Development Guide
text: dicomtk comprehensive, CRAN-ready R package wrapping OFFIS DICOM Toolkit (DCMTK 3.7.1) via native Rcpp bindings, designed : 1. Self-contained C++ bundling: Bundles trimmed DCMTK source inside src/dcmtk/ compiled R CMD INSTALL (fallback/hybrid support system DCMTK CMake builds) built-DICOM dictionary (DCM_DICT_DEFAULT_USE_BUILTIN). 2. Tidyverse compliance: Returns tibble objects (tbl_df), uses snake_case function names, supports pipe-friendly (|>) workflows, integrates dplyr/tidyr. 3. Comprehensive DCMTK coverage: - Core (dcmdata): Header parsing (read_dicom(), read_dicom_header(), dicom_tags()), tag modification (dicom_modify()), de-identification/anonymization (dicom_anonymize()), XML/JSON/PDF conversion (dcm2xml(), dcm2json(), dcm2pdf()). - Image Processing & Codecs (dcmimgle, dcmimage, dcmjpeg, dcmjpls): Pixel extraction (read_dicom_pixels(), read_dicom_series()), VOI LUT & window/level presets (dicom_window()), RLE/JPEG/JPEG-LS compression decompression (dicom_compress(), dicom_decompress()), PNG/NIfTI export (dicom_to_png(), dicom_to_nifti()). - Visualization: Static ggplot2 plotting (plot_dicom(), ggdicom()), interactive Shiny multi-slice viewer (dicom_viewer()), 3D volume rendering via rgl (render_volume()). - Networking (dcmnet, dcmqrdb, dcmwlm): PACS connectivity (dicom_connect(), dicom_echo(), dicom_find(), dicom_get(), dicom_send(), dicom_receive()). - Structured Reporting & Advanced IODs (dcmsr, dcmrt, dcmseg, dcmpmap, dcmtract, dcmect, dcmpstat, dcmsign, dcmtls): Reading creating DICOM SR, RT Structure Sets/Dose/Plan, Segmentations, Parametric Maps, Tractography. 4. LLM Integration: Unified AI assistant interface (dicom_llm(), dicom_summarize(), dicom_describe_image(), dicom_report(), dicom_ask(), dicom_tag_lookup()) supporting local Ollama models OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure, local vLLM/LM Studio) HIPAA-aware automatic de-identification cloud transmission.

Tidyverse Compliant: tabular functions (read_dicom(), dicom_tags(), dicom_find(), read_dicom_sr(), dicom_report()) return tibble objects (tbl_df) compose naturally |> dplyr/tidyr. Core (dcmdata): read_dicom(), read_dicom_header(), write_dicom(), dicom_tags(), dicom_modify(), dicom_tag_value(), dicom_tag_lookup(), dicom_anonymize(), dcm2xml(), dcm2json(), dcm2pdf(). Image Processing & Codecs (dcmimgle, dcmimage, dcmjpeg, dcmjpls): read_dicom_pixels(), read_dicom_series(), dicom_window(), dicom_compress(), dicom_decompress(), dicom_to_png(), dicom_to_nifti(). Visualization: plot_dicom() ggdicom() (ggplot2 clinical CT/MR window presets), dicom_viewer() (interactive Shiny app), render_volume() (3-plane MPR, MIP, interactive rgl 3D rendering). PACS Networking (dcmnet, dcmqrdb, dcmwlm): dicom_connect(), dicom_echo(), dicom_find(), dicom_get(), dicom_send(), dicom_receive(). Structured Reporting & Specialized IODs (dcmsr, dcmrt, dcmseg, dcmpmap, dcmtract, dcmect, dcmsign): read_dicom_sr(), create_dicom_sr(), read_dicom_rt(), read_dicom_seg(), read_dicom_pmap(), read_dicom_ect(), dicom_verify_signature(). Native support local Ollama (http://localhost:11434), OpenAI (gpt-4o, etc.), Anthropic Claude (claude-sonnet-4-20250514, etc.), OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Azure). Automatic HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification sending metadata images remote APIs. 100% Backward Compatible: Preserves legacy dcmtk functions (dcmdump(), dcmhd(), wide_hdr(), burned_annot(), dcmodify(), dcm_anon(), dcm_subtract_date(), dcmj2pnm(), dcmdjpeg(), dcmdrle(), dcmcrle()).

title: dicomtk 0.1.0
text: Initial release dicomtk, full rebuild dcmtk R wrapper synchronized OFFIS DCMTK 3.7.1 (PS 3.6-2026d). Bundled complete 5,354-tag DCMTK 3.7.1 data dictionary, 23 module header trees (inst/include/dcmtk/), self-contained C++17 / Rcpp engine requiring external installation. Added tidyverse-compliant DICOM /O tag functions (read_dicom(), read_dicom_header(), read_dicom_pixels(), read_dicom_series(), write_dicom(), dicom_tags(), dicom_tag_value(), dicom_modify(), dicom_tag_lookup()). Added HIPAA Safe Harbor DICOM PS3.15 de-identification (dicom_anonymize()) date shifting, private tag removal, UID regeneration. Added ggplot2 visualization (plot_dicom(), ggdicom(), dicom_window() clinical CT presets), interactive Shiny viewer (dicom_viewer()), 3D volume rendering (render_volume() MPR, MIP, rgl). Added PACS networking (dicom_connect(), dicom_echo(), dicom_find(), dicom_get(), dicom_send(), dicom_receive(), dicom_qrdb_index(), dicom_worklist(), dicom_tls_config()). Added Structured Reporting specialized IOD interfaces (read_dicom_sr(), create_dicom_sr(), read_dicom_rt(), read_dicom_seg(), read_dicom_pmap(), read_dicom_tract(), read_dicom_pstate(), read_dicom_ect(), dicom_verify_signature()). Added unified LLM integration (dicom_llm(), dicom_summarize(), dicom_describe_image(), dicom_report(), dicom_ask()) supporting local Ollama OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure, vLLM, LM Studio). Maintained full backward compatibility legacy dcmtk functions (dcmdump(), dcmhd(), wide_hdr(), burned_annot(), dcmodify(), dcm_anon(), dcm_subtract_date(), dcmj2pnm(), dcmdjpeg(), dcmdrle(), dcmcrle()).
